shapes: receiver-qualified same-name call (this.items.get inside Store.get) — artifact, must be dropped and declared
genuine recursion (loop → loop) — must be kept and labeled recursive
mutual pair (a ↔ b) — must not error
3-deep chain (top → mid → deep) — must expand without error
one caller with two call sites (many → deep ×2) — both ranges reported

limitations: the analyzer stores relationship line_number = 0 for every row today; the call-site positions here are derived from the caller's own source, which is why they are exact. The stored-value path (a future analyzer change) is exercised only as a declared fallback.
invocation scanning is line-comment aware but not string-literal aware (declared in the component header); every result is bounded by the caller's own declaration range.
